$ sccfm-cli inventory devices asa cli execute --help

Usage: sccfm-cli inventory devices asa cli execute [OPTIONS]

  Execute CLI commands on ASA devices.

Options:
  -n, --device-name TEXT      Device name to search for (supports wildcards like
                              'branch-*').
  -q, --query TEXT            Filter devices to execute the CLI on by a Lucene
                              query.
  -l, --limit INTEGER RANGE   Maximum records to return  [default: 50;
                              1<=x<=200]
  -o, --offset INTEGER RANGE  Pagination offset  [default: 0; x>=0]
  -u, --device-uids TEXT      List of device UIDs to execute the CLI on.
  -s, --script TEXT           ASA commands to execute, with each command
                              separated by \n.
  -f, --script-file PATH      Path to a file containing ASA commands to execute,
                              with each command separated by a newline.
  --check                     Run a preflight check without performing the
                              operation.
  --format [table|json]       Output format  [default: table]
  --config-path PATH          Path to the configuration file (defaults to
                              ~/.sccfm-cli/config.json).
  --help                      Show this message and exit.
